_comment: SPEC-04 Teil 2.3 — the metrics that CANNOT be measured in operation.
These numbers come from an offline evaluation set and are maintained by
hand. That is not a defect of this repository; it is the unsolved core
problem of the field (HANDBUCH 7.6): without ground truth there is no
accuracy in operation, only proxies. The doctor's correction before
release WOULD be the label, but that feedback channel does not exist yet.
They live in their own file, separate from anything the eval runner
measures, so that the boundary between measured and asserted is a file
boundary and not a matter of reading carefully. eval_runner.py copies
them into the result document under provenance 'declared'.
Whoever edits this file is asserting these numbers. That is allowed. It
_note: Kein Ground-Truth-Kanal im Betrieb — siehe HANDBUCH 7.6. Nicht als Betriebsmessung verwendbar.
